Each strike expires after 90 days and adds 1 point; a serious strike adds 2. With 2 points, 24 hours without posting; with 3, a 7-day suspension; with 4 or more, the account is closed. Some violations cause immediate closure. If you think we got it wrong, email fogonapps@gmail.com within 30 days.

For child sexual abuse: close the account, report it to the Police CAI Virtual or the Prosecutor’s Office, and do not download or forward the content. The server keeps it isolated for the authorities.
